{"ok":true,"status":"done","resultId":"res_0232","data":{"path":"knowledge/facts/expense-policy.md","frontmatter":{"id":"fact-expense-policy","type":"fact","aliases":[],"links":["entities/company/cmp_larkspur.md"],"sources":["seed"],"status":null,"updated":"2026-01-01","taintedBy":null},"body":"# Expense policy (version 1, effective Jan 1, 2026)

What Weft checks on every claim before a person decides it. Policy limits are the company's; rates come from the IRS and GSA.

- Receipts: lodging always needs one, and so does any other expense of $75.00 or more (2026-01-01, src: IRS Publication 463, chapter 5)
- Client and team meals: up to $75.00 per person, counting everyone at the table; list the attendees and the business purpose (2026-01-01, src: Larkspur expense policy v1)
- Hotel stays: up to the standard night rate, $110.00 a night through Sep 30, 2026 and $113.00 from Oct 1, 2026 (2026-01-01, src: GSA per diem bulletin FTR 27-01)
- Meals on a trip: $68.00 a day, $51.00 on the first and last day (2026-01-01, src: GSA per diem bulletin FTR 27-01)
- Mileage: the IRS standard rate on the day of the drive, 72.5 cents a mile through Jun 30, 2026 and 76 cents from Jul 1, 2026 (2026-01-01, src: IRS standard mileage rates for 2026)
- Software: up to $50.00 a month per tool (2026-01-01, src: Larkspur expense policy v1)
